about: [C4] after the critic (M4): after the fight the room answers - the docker, the jukebox, Dot, the cook, a stool walked into

steps.look: (() => { const a = (G.scenes.ctx.cast.get('docker').bones.head.getWorldPosition(new N.THREE.Vector3())); const yw = Math.atan2(-(a.x - G.eye.x), -(a.z - G.eye.z)); const pt = Math.atan2(a.y - G.eye.y, Math.hypot(a.x - G.eye.x, a.z - G.eye.z)); const d = Math.atan2(Math.sin(yw - N.controller.yaw), Math.cos(yw - N.controller.yaw)); return [Math.round(-d / N.controller.sensitivity), Math.round(-(pt - N.controller.pitch) / N.controller.sensitivity)]; })()

steps.eval: JSON.stringify((()=>{const h=G.interact.list.find(h=>h.id==='c4.docker'); const a=h.at(); const c=G.camera.position; const f=new N.THREE.Vector3(0,0,-1).transformDirection(G.camera.matrixWorld); const p=a.clone().sub(c); const d=p.length(); return {a:[a.x,a.y,a.z], d, ang: Math.acos(p.dot(f)/d), when: h.when(), range: h.range, cone: h.cone, mode: N.controller.mode, list: G.interact.list.length, prompting: !!G.scenes.prompting, insp: !!G.inspect.active, state: G.state};})())
